overview: This House resolution has the Speaker appoint two members to tell the President that the House has a quorum (enough members present to do business) and is ready to receive any message the President wishes to send. It is a traditional step the House takes at the start of each new session of Congress. The House agreed to it on January 6, 2026.
for: Supporters say it is a routine, long-standing step in opening a new session of Congress.
against: Critics say it is a ceremonial procedural measure that doesn't change any law or spending.
